name: Headcount Plan vs Actual
note: Every figure is read off one monthly movement ledger per department (opening + hires − exits ± transfers), so the stacked bars, the bridge waterfall, the KPI counters (integers tweened through a registered @property) and the subgrid variance list always tie; Oct–Dec are a probability-weighted forecast from open roles, so moving a role's stage or start month in its drawer re-lands the year live. Set --dhr-plan-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Engagement Survey Results
note: Diverging Likert bars centred on neutral: each stack is one flex row translated by its own share of disagree-plus-half-neutral, so a team switch only retunes custom properties and every segment glides; sort and theme roll-up re-order keyed rows with FLIP on the Web Animations API, response-rate rings fill through a registered @property angle, and counts are apportioned by largest remainder so every row sums to its responses. name: Labour Cost Treemap
note: A squarified treemap (Bruls et al.) of payroll built up from per-team monthly components; tiles are keyed buttons positioned in pixels, and every re-layout (period, cost components, drilling into a department) is a FLIP that animates only transform on each tile's background and label, so the department zooms out of its own rectangle. Tiles recolour between department hues and a diverging budget-variance scale with color-mix() in oklch. Set --dhr-labour-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Pay Equity Bands
note: Every person is a button placed in their level's band by compa-ratio with translate: calc(var(--x) * 100cqi) inside an inline-size container, so position is pure transform and modelling a correction just retunes --x and the dots spring right, leaving a trail sized in the same cqi units; unadjusted and within-level gaps (medians, weighted by headcount) are recomputed for either lens. name: Absence & Overtime Cover
note: Every figure comes from simulated rotas and absence spells, so the calendar heatmap (a real ARIA grid of day cells sized by a size-container query so they stay square at any width), the weekday profile, the Bradford factor table (S² × D, long-term sickness excluded) and the DPR-aware canvas of weekly hours lost vs overtime worked all agree; filters recolour cells in place and the cover chart reports the Pearson correlation it draws.
